reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent Dana the list in our direct message, replying to her message. I read all six of Moss's notes in the shared files.

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their bay-assignment texts from the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet", which has no date. Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

I also told Dana what I left out and why:
- Moss's 14 Sept 2025 North pipeline digest and 23 Mar 2026 renewal note both mention Quarrendon but give no ticket number.
- Tickets #4409 and #4412 and the feature request FR-882 are in Moss's Central team notes and belong to Central accounts, not Quarrendon.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer, and it isn't one of Moss's notes.

The two numbers are formatted differently (only one has the "PD-" prefix), and the cheat sheet isn't dated. I suggested Dana check both in the ticket system before they go into the weekly notes.
